summary: This program asks for a temperature and gives clothing advice, choosing between three possible messages depending on how cold or hot it is.

lines.text: input always hands back text, so float converts what the reader typed into a decimal number that can be compared with 10 and 30.
The first condition is checked first; if it is true, the rest of the chain is skipped entirely.
elif means "otherwise, check this instead," so this test only runs when the temperature was not below 10 -- that is what makes the three outcomes mutually exclusive.
The else branch catches everything left over, here the comfortable range from 10 up to 30, so the program always prints exactly one message.
